title: Clyde Tombaugh's ashes on New Horizons

tellings.quote: But, in fact, the most embarrassing thing was New Horizons, which was sent to explore Pluto. Mhm. And uh NASA decided to put uh 30 g of ashes of the person who discovered Pluto, Clyde Tombaugh, the scientist.

plain: A Harvard scientist named Avi Loeb, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that NASA put about 30 grams of the ashes of Clyde Tombaugh, the scientist who discovered Pluto, aboard New Horizons, the spacecraft sent to explore Pluto. Loeb calls this "the most embarrassing thing," using it to make a point about what humans choose to send into space, and what that would say to anyone who found it.
